auth.label: Key Secret
auth.description: Razorpay Key Secret used together with your Key ID for HTTP Basic Authentication. Generate API keys in Razorpay Dashboard > Account & Settings > API Keys.

extraFields.label: Key ID
extraFields.description: Razorpay Key ID paired with the Key Secret for HTTP Basic Authentication.

actions.name: create_order
actions.description: Create a Razorpay order for an amount, currency, and optional receipt metadata.

amount.description: The order amount in the smallest currency subunit.

currency.description: The three-letter ISO currency code for the order.

receipt.description: Your internal receipt reference. Razorpay allows up to 40 characters.

notes.description: Key-value pairs forwarded to Razorpay notes. Razorpay accepts up to 15 pairs.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for creating a Razorpay order.

id.description: The unique identifier of the Razorpay order.

entity.description: The entity type returned by Razorpay.

amount.description: The order amount in the smallest currency subunit.

anyOf.description: The amount paid against the order.

amountPaid.description: The amount paid against the order.

anyOf.description: The amount still due for the order.

amountDue.description: The amount still due for the order.

currency.description: The ISO currency code used for the order.

anyOf.description: Your internal receipt reference when present.

receipt.description: Your internal receipt reference when present.

anyOf.description: The Razorpay offer identifier when present.

offerId.description: The Razorpay offer identifier when present.

anyOf.description: The order status returned by Razorpay.

status.description: The order status returned by Razorpay.

anyOf.description: The number of payment attempts recorded for the order.

attempts.description: The number of payment attempts recorded for the order.

notes.description: The notes payload returned by Razorpay.

anyOf.description: The Unix timestamp when the order was created.

createdAt.description: The Unix timestamp when the order was created.

outputSchema.description: The response returned when creating a Razorpay order.

actions.name: create_refund
actions.description: Create a Razorpay refund for a payment, with optional amount, speed, and notes.

paymentId.description: The Razorpay payment identifier to refund.

amount.description: The refund amount in the smallest currency subunit.

speed.description: The refund processing speed requested from Razorpay.

notes.description: Key-value pairs forwarded to Razorpay notes. Razorpay accepts up to 15 pairs.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for creating a Razorpay refund.

id.description: The unique identifier of the Razorpay refund.

entity.description: The entity type returned by Razorpay.

amount.description: The refund amount in the smallest currency subunit.

currency.description: The ISO currency code used for the refund.

paymentId.description: The Razorpay payment identifier linked to the refund.

anyOf.description: Your internal refund receipt reference when present.

receipt.description: Your internal refund receipt reference when present.

notes.description: The notes payload returned by Razorpay.

acquirerData.description: The dynamic acquirer data returned by Razorpay.

anyOf.description: The Unix timestamp when the refund was created.

createdAt.description: The Unix timestamp when the refund was created.

anyOf.description: The Razorpay batch identifier when present.

batchId.description: The Razorpay batch identifier when present.

anyOf.description: The refund status returned by Razorpay.

status.description: The refund status returned by Razorpay.

anyOf.description: The refund speed requested in the original call.

speedRequested.description: The refund speed requested in the original call.

anyOf.description: The refund speed actually processed by Razorpay.

speedProcessed.description: The refund speed actually processed by Razorpay.

outputSchema.description: The response returned when creating a Razorpay refund.
